title: MRE: MINECRAFT RPG EDITION
description: this modpacks changes minecraft by making it into a RPG style game
body:
A cozy-but-alive Minecraft experience focused on immersive villages, farming, and NPC life.

This modpack brings Minecraft worlds to life with deeper interactions, improved village generation, and a more engaging survival loop. Build, farm, and explore a world that actually feels populated instead of empty cardboard villages.

✨ Main features:
🏡 Enhanced villages with more variety and structure
👥 Real NPC interactions and relationships with Minecraft Comes Alive (MCA)
🌾 Expanded cooking, farming, and food systems with Farmer’s Delight
🌍 Better world feel with improved village generation and layout
🌱 Gameplay vibe:

Relaxed survival with more personality. You’re not just surviving anymore—you’re living in a world that reacts, grows, and feels a bit more human.

Perfect for chill survival runs, roleplay worlds, or just escaping sweaty PvP servers for a bit.
